title: 第6章 南家小姐来了
slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣
content_zh:
第6章南家小姐来了
宿鸟动前林，晨光上东屋。
一如这三个多月以来的清晨。
清晨鸟雀的啼鸣刚刚响起，陆景就已经起床了。
早晨读书，效果自然最好。
洗漱之后，陆景便迎着晨辉，继续苦读。
《中正》、《尚学》、《圣言》、《问诗》，这四部经典，原身俱都已经熟读，但倘若要论及精通，却还不够。
陆景原身在八九年的时间里，已然读了四部典籍上千余遍。
这大伏四大儒学经典，能够被如此之多的儒家大圣推崇，自然有其原因。
比如此刻摆在桌上的，是一本《圣言》。
《圣言》，乃是夫子德行汇编成为的典籍，是唯一著作者仍然在世的经典。
哪怕夫子已经四十八年不曾出世，但他的地位，却不曾有损，反而越发崇高，便如同北斗之星，指引无数读书人前行。
就连大伏天崇帝也曾经道：“夫子正于天上修文，观天上学问四十余载，归来时，雪落人间，学问也落人间。”
正因为如此，儒学在大伏是庙堂之道，非道佛能够相提并论。
天下读书人，出路便在儒学，而儒学最为核心的要义，就在那四本经典之中。
陆景之所以坚持读书，原因也在于此处。
“现在我身坠贱籍，许多人都觉得我读书无用，可我却觉得遭逢此难，读书恰恰有用。”
“现在如果我不读书，便也无所事事，终日不过怨天尤人，无法改变现状。
若我潜心苦读，一是能够潜心静气，增长气度；二则能积累学问，等到他日万一有机会来临，我也能顺利抓住机会。”
《周易-系辞下》：“君子藏器于身，待时而动，何不利之有。”

这其中的道理，陆景通读周易，自然知晓。
清早的课业，除了认真读书之外，比往常又多了一项。
便是观想！
大明王焱天大圣观想图在区区一夜之后，便已经被陆景烙印在脑海中。
八卦内相中的“功”栏中，也多了一门【大明王焱天大圣观想法】。
清晨刚从睡梦中醒来，还不曾下床，陆景就已经盘坐在床上，观想了一遍大明王焱天大圣。
十二息时间极为短暂，却已经让陆景精神十分疲惫。
然而陆景并未继续酣睡歇息，而是起身洗漱用过早粥之后，在在院中闲逛了一刻钟。
等到心神稍稍恢复，就回到房中读书。
陆景并不图快，往往看一刻钟，便休息半刻，以免自己心力不济，反倒伤了身体。
可哪怕是这样，现在因为有了命格【勤勉刻苦】的助力，陆景看书时更加专注，却很难疲惫。
足足两个时辰过去，陆景只觉得自己气息越发悠长，精神也越发饱满，和清晨起床时一般无二。
“继续观想。”
陆景将眼前的【圣言】合上，闭目观想大明王。
十二息时间过去，陆景缓缓睁开眼睛。
“第一次观想，只觉得无论是气力体魄还是精神都提升巨大，其后再观想，却又觉得这大明王观想法并非是烈火烹油，其势爆裂，反而如同春雨，润物细无声。”
陆景短短三次观想，就已经能够十分清楚的感觉到自己身体的变化。
可对于修行，陆景还是一无所知。
“天下武学分九品之境，究竟是哪九品？不知我何时才能够踏入武学之境。”
人总是对于未知的事充满向往和好奇。

读书，陆景前世就已经读过了。
但是习武，却还还没有尝试过的新事物。
正在陆景思索的时候。
青玥的声音从门外传来：“少爷，午饭好了。”
陆景听到青玥缓慢而又柔和的声音，陆景心里多出几分暖意。
昨日夜晚，在融合了原身的魂灵之后，陆景脑海中同样多出了许多记忆。
这些记忆中有很多是关于青玥的。
比如就在半年之前，陆家二府大少爷陆烽就曾经向陆景讨要过姿色出众、心性温柔的青玥。
当时的陆景已沦为赘婿贱籍，只觉得种种希望已经破灭，心有死志，所以就曾想将青玥送给陆烽。
毕竟在陆烽府里，总没有人再来折辱，平日里吃穿用度，也能好上不少。
可最终，青玥一言不发的跪在陆景娘亲的灵牌前，倔强望着陆景，眼中满噙泪水，无声反抗。
陆景最终也是心软，没有将青玥送出去。
“少爷，过了日中，还要去琉光水榭请安，你莫要忘了。”
青玥用过朴素简单却十分温馨的午饭，便给陆景带出一套蓝色长衫，伺候陆景更衣。
陆景早已习惯了这些，也并不避讳青玥。
青玥一边给陆景换衣服，一边碎碎道：“这次不能再迟到，上次少爷生病，去迟了半刻，刘管事便克扣了一两的月钱。”
陆景笑道：“不过是刘管事敛财的手段，我就算不去，老太君也自不会在意的。
毕竟现在，我其实已经不算是陆家人了。”
青玥闻言，面色露出几分担忧：“少爷，南国公府不会真的想要毁约……”
青玥话语未落。

“吱呀……”
一道极轻的开门声传入陆景的耳朵。
放在昨日以前，陆景是万万听不到如此轻微的声音的。
短短一夜，陆景便有如脱胎换骨，五觉都敏锐了许多。
“来人了。”
陆景刚刚提醒青玥，门外就有喊话声：“景少爷在吗？”
青玥听到声音，认出了来人：“是老太君身边的锦葵姐姐。”
“她从不曾来过我们院里，不知是出了什么事？”
青玥脸上带着疑惑和紧张。
陆景不做反应，束发之后，站起身来
却见门外有一位少女，二八年华，面貌姣好，右眉出一处美人痣，配丹凤眼，美艳之余，又显得颇为精明。
这少女，身穿娟纱金丝绣花长裙，用料一等一，哪怕是京城有些官宅里嫡出的少爷小姐，都穿不上这种的衣服。
陆景身上的衣服，和这少女身上的相比，仍然要差上不知多少。
陆景自然知道这少女。
她是陆府老太君身边的大丫鬟，名叫锦葵，十分得宠。
在府里的地位更不必说，莫说是陆景，就连其他得宠的庶出少爷，在老太君眼里，分量都没有这锦葵来得重。
“景少爷。”
令陆景没想到的是，锦葵看到陆景，福身行礼，脸上还挂着几分笑意。
并没有寻常管事看到他那般，毫无敬意。
陆景朝着锦葵笑了笑，倒也没有露出什么受宠若惊的表情，道：“大姑娘来了寒舍，就请进屋饮茶，休憩一番，避一避这晌午的热气。”

锦葵不知为何，仔细看陆景几眼，这才道：“锦葵念景少爷的好，只是锦葵此来是传老太君的话。
日中之后，请景少爷务必要迟些前来琉光水榭，莫要来的太早了。”
“传了话，我还要回水榭回禀，就只能谢过少爷的好意了。”
“迟些去请安递茶？”陆景点头应是，正要说些客气话。
锦葵突然笑道：“几日不见，景少爷的气色越来越好了，样貌也越为不凡，如果南家小姐看到少爷，心里必然高兴。”
“而且今日老太君和钟大夫人，还在商议要考校族里子弟的学问，趁着天时还早，景少爷还可以读一读《中正》。”
锦葵客套几句，推门离去。
青玥有些疑惑的对陆景说道：“奇怪，老太君怎么专程让锦葵姑娘传话……”
“倒是欠了她一句人情。”陆景关上房门，随意道：“她不是已经说了吗？
南家小姐来了。”
content_en:
Chapter 6 Miss Nan is here
The local birds are moving in the front forest, and the morning light is shining in the east room.
Just like this morning for more than three months.
As soon as the birds chirped in the morning, Lu Jing had already gotten up.
Reading in the morning is naturally the best.
After washing, Lu Jing faced Chen Hui and continued to study hard.
"Zhongzheng", "Shangxue", "Shengyan", and "Wen Shi", these four classics have all been familiar to me, but if we want to talk about mastery, it is not enough.
Lu Jingyuan has read four classics more than a thousand times in the past eight or nine years.
There is naturally a reason why these four major Confucian classics can be praised by so many Confucian sages.
For example, what is on the table right now is a copy of the Holy Word.
The Holy Word is a collection of Confucius' virtues and is the only classic whose author is still alive.
Even though the Master has not been born for forty-eight years, his status has not been damaged, but has become more noble, just like the Big Dipper, guiding countless scholars forward.
Even Dafutian Chongdi once said: "The Master was practicing writing in heaven and observing the knowledge in heaven for more than forty years. When he returned, the snow fell on the earth and the knowledge also fell on the earth."
Because of this, Confucianism is the way of temples in Dafu, and non-Taoism and Buddhism cannot be compared.
The way out for scholars all over the world is Confucianism, and the core essence of Confucianism is found in those four classics.
This is also the reason why Lu Jing insists on studying.
"Now that I am in a lowly position, many people think that it is useless for me to study, but I feel that studying is just useful in this difficult situation."
"Now if I don't study, I will have nothing to do. I will just complain all day long and cannot change the status quo.
If I study hard, firstly, I can concentrate on calming down and increase my tolerance; secondly, I can accumulate knowledge, so that if the opportunity comes in the future, I can successfully seize the opportunity. "
"Book of Changes - Xici Xia": "A gentleman hides his weapons in his body and waits for the time to move. What's the disadvantage?"
Lu Jing naturally knew the reason behind this after reading the Book of Changes.
In addition to studying hard, the early morning homework included one more item than usual.
Just visualize!
The visualization of the Ming Dynasty King Yantian and the Great Sage was already imprinted in Lu Jing's mind after just one night.
In the "Gong" column of the Bagua Internal Phrase, there is also an additional one [The Concept of the Great Sage Yantian of the Ming Dynasty].
Lu Jing had just woken up from his sleep in the morning, and before he even got out of bed, Lu Jing was already sitting cross-legged on the bed, visualizing the Great Sage Yantian, King of the Ming Dynasty.
The twelve breaths were extremely short, but they had already made Lu Jing mentally exhausted.
However, Lu Jing did not continue to sleep soundly. Instead, he got up, washed himself, had breakfast, and wandered around the courtyard for a quarter of an hour.
After he recovered a little, he went back to his room to read.
Lu Jing didn't try to be quick. He would often watch for a quarter of an hour and then rest for half an hour, so as not to lose his mental strength and injure his body.
But even so, now with the help of his destiny [diligence and hard work], Lu Jing is more focused when reading, but it is hard to get tired.
Two full hours passed, and Lu Jing felt that his breath was getting longer and his energy was getting fuller, just like when he got up in the morning.
"Keep visualizing."
Lu Jing closed the [Holy Word] in front of him, closed his eyes and contemplated the Great Ming King.
Twelve breaths passed, and Lu Jing slowly opened his eyes.
"When I visualized it for the first time, I felt that both my strength, body and spirit had improved tremendously. After I visualized it again, I felt that this visualization of the Great Ming King was not like a burning fire cooking oil, with its power exploding, but like spring rain, moistening things silently."
Lu Jing could clearly feel the changes in his body after just three meditations.
But Lu Jing still knew nothing about cultivation.
"There are nine levels of martial arts in the world. Which level is it? I don't know when I will be able to enter the realm of martial arts."
People are always full of yearning and curiosity about unknown things.
Lu Jing had already read books in his previous life.
But I haven’t tried martial arts yet.new things.
While Lu Jing was thinking.
Qing Yue's voice came from outside the door: "Master, lunch is ready."
When Lu Jing heard Qing Yue's slow and soft voice, Lu Jing felt a little warmer in his heart.
Last night, after fusing the original soul, Lu Jing also had many more memories in his mind.
Many of these memories are about Qing Yue.
For example, just half a year ago, Lu Feng, the eldest son of the second house of the Lu family, asked Lu Jing for Qing Yue, who was outstanding in appearance and gentle in nature.
At that time, Lu Jing had become a lowly son-in-law. He felt that all his hopes had been shattered and he was determined to die, so he wanted to give Qing Yue to Lu Feng.
After all, in Lu Feng's house, no one would come to humiliate him again, and his daily food and clothing expenses would be much better.
But in the end, Qing Yue knelt in front of Lu Jing's mother's spiritual tablet without saying a word, and looked at Lu Jing stubbornly, with tears in her eyes, resisting silently.
Lu Jing finally relented and did not send Qing Yue out.
"Master, after noon, you have to go to Liuguang Water Pavilion to pay your respects. Don't forget it."
After Qingyue had a simple but very warm lunch, she brought out a blue gown for Lu Jing and helped Lu Jing change.
Lu Jing has long been accustomed to this and does not shy away from Qing Yue.
While Qing Yue was changing Lu Jing's clothes, she said in a low voice, "We can't be late this time. Last time, the young master was ill and was half a minute late, so Manager Liu deducted one tael of monthly payment."
Lu Jing smiled and said: "It's just a way for Manager Liu to make money. Even if I don't go, the old lady won't care.
After all, now, I am actually no longer a member of the Lu family. "
Hearing this, Qing Yue looked a little worried: "Young Master, the Duke of Nanguo really doesn't want to break the contract..."
Qing Yue's words have not yet finished.
"Squeak..."
A very soft sound of the door opening reached Lu Jing's ears.
Before yesterday, Lu Jing would never have heard such a slight sound.
In just one night, Lu Jing felt as if he had been reborn, and his five senses were much sharper.
"Someone is coming."
Just as Lu Jing reminded Qing Yue, there was a voice calling outside the door: "Is Master Jing here?"
Qing Yue heard the voice and recognized the person: "It's Sister Malkui next to the old lady."
"She has never been to our courtyard. I wonder what happened?"
Qing Yue had doubts and nervousness on her face.
Lu Jing didn't react. After tying his hair, he stood up.
But he saw a young girl outside the door. She was twenty-eight years old and had a good face. She had a beauty mark on her right eyebrow and red and phoenix eyes. Besides being beautiful, she also looked quite shrewd.
This girl was wearing a long dress embroidered with gold silk and silk. The materials were of the highest quality. Even the young masters and ladies who were direct descendants of some official houses in the capital could not wear such clothes.
Compared with the clothes on this girl, Lu Jing's clothes were still much different.
Lu Jing naturally knew this girl.
She is the eldest maid of the old lady of the Lu family, her name is Jin Kui, and she is very favored.
Not to mention his status in the mansion, not to mention Lu Jing, even other favored concubine young masters were not as important as this mallow in the eyes of the old lady.
"Master Jing."
What Lu Jing didn't expect was that when Mallow saw Lu Jing, she bowed with a smile on her face.
He was not as disrespectful as ordinary stewards would be when they saw him.
Lu Jing smiled at Mallow, but did not show any flattered expression, and said: "When the eldest lady comes to the humble house, please come in to drink tea, take a rest, and avoid the heat of the afternoon."
For some reason, Mallow looked at Lu Jing carefully and then said, "Mallow appreciates the kindness of Master Jing, but Mallow is here to spread the words of the old lady.
After noon, I ask Master Jing to come to Liuguang Water Pavilion later and don't come too early. "
"After passing the message, I have to go back to Shuixie to report back, so I can only thank the young master for his kindness."
"Will you ask An to bring you tea later?" Lu Ding nodded and was about to say some kind words.
Jin Kui suddenly smiled and said, "We haven't seen each other for a few days. Master Jing's complexion is getting worse and worse."The better he is, the more extraordinary he looks. If Miss Nan sees the young master, she will definitely be happy. "
"And today the old lady and Mrs. Zhong are still discussing how to test the knowledge of the children of the school clan. While it is still early, Master Jing can also read "Zhongzheng". "
Mallow said a few polite words, opened the door and left.
Qing Yue said to Lu Jing with some confusion: "It's strange why the old lady specially asked Miss Malkui to pass the message..."
“I owe her a favor. Lu Jing closed the door and said casually: "Didn't she already say it?"
Miss Nan is here. "
